headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: May 19, 2026**
article:
The Cleveland Guardians secured a dominant 8-2 victory over the Detroit Tigers, with Slade Cecconi earning the win. José Ramírez led the Guardians' offense, hitting 3 home runs, including a 8th homer on a fly ball to left field.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, impacting their teams' lineups. The Toronto Blue Jays placed left-handed pitcher Joe Mantiply on the 15-day injured list due to left knee inflammation, effective retroactive to May 18, 2026. The New York Mets transferred RHP Clay Holmes from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to a right fibula fracture. The Minnesota Twins also made several roster moves, transferring RHP Garrett Acton from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to a right shoulder strain and placing C Ryan Jeffers on the 10-day injured list with a left hamate bone fracture.

The Los Angeles Dodgers made a significant trade, acquiring LHP Eric Lauer from the Toronto Blue Jays for cash. The Chicago White Sox also made a trade, acquiring CF Junior Perez from the Athletics in exchange for LHP Jackson Nove. The Athletics traded RHP Kyle Robinson to the Pittsburgh Pirates for 2B Alika Williams and traded RHP Eduarniel Núñez to the Baltimore Orioles for cash.

top_news.title: **Guardians Take Down Tigers 8-2**
top_news.summary: The Cleveland Guardians secured an 8-2 victory over the Detroit Tigers, with Slade Cecconi earning the win. José Ramírez led the Guardians' offense, hitting 3 home runs, including a 8th homer on a fly ball to left field.

top_news.title: **Rays Rout Orioles 16-6**
top_news.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays dominated the Baltimore Orioles, securing a 16-6 victory. Junior Caminero led the Orioles' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 4 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Reds Fall Short in Philly**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds dropped a 4-5 decision to the Philadelphia Phillies in a closely contested matchup. Bryson Stott led the Phillies' offense with a home run and two RBIs.

top_news.title: **Braves Suffer Worst Loss of Season, 12-0**
top_news.summary: The Atlanta Braves fell to the Miami Marlins in a lopsided 12-0 game, marking their worst loss of the season. Javier Sanoja led the Braves' offense with a home run and four RBIs.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays Place Joe Mantiply on 15-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays have placed left-handed pitcher Joe Mantiply on the 15-day injured list due to left knee inflammation, effective retroactive to May 18, 2026.

top_news.title: **Lauer Joins Dodgers in Latest Trade**
top_news.summary: Eric Lauer has been traded to the Los Angeles Dodgers, marking the latest move in a busy offseason. The exact terms of the trade, which involved the Toronto Blue Jays, have not been disclosed.
